mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_item ( goods_no, item_no, item_name, item_price, stock, goods_status_code, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time ) VALUES ( #{goodsNo}, #{itemNo}, #{itemName}, #{itemPrice}, #{stock}, #{goodsStatusCode}, #{registId}, #{registDateTime}, #{modifyId}, #{modifyDateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT goods_no, item_no, item_name, item_price, stock, goods_status_code, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM goods_item
SELECT goods_no, item_no, item_name, item_price, stock, goods_status_code, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM goods_item WHERE goods_no = #{param1} AND item_no = #{param2}
mapper.update: UPDATE goods_item SET item_name = #{itemName}, item_price = #{itemPrice}, stock = #{stock}, goods_status_code = #{goodsStatusCode}, modify_id = #{modifyId}, modify_date_time = #{modifyDateTime} WHERE goods_no = #{goodsNo} AND item_no = #{itemNo}
